prompt: Shape2D.java is a provided abstract class. Write CircleShape.java and the nested SquareShape inside AreaReport.java, then make AreaReport's totalArea, largestName and summary work on any Shape2D.
explanation: An abstract class can hold shared state and behaviour -- the name field and toString here -- while leaving area() for each subclass to supply. Each subclass passes its name up with super("circle") or super("square") and overrides perimeter(), whose base version is only a placeholder. The report methods declare Shape2D parameters, so every call to area() is dispatched to the actual subclass at run time: that is polymorphism, and it means new shapes need no changes to the report.
hints: The first statement of each subclass constructor must be the super(...) call that sets the name.
area() is abstract, so it must be implemented; perimeter() is not, so you override it to replace the 0.0 default.
For summary, String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%s: %.2f", name, area) gives exactly two decimals -- join the lines with "\n" and put no newline after the last one.
